newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wrightson shrs hit year high of NZ$1.24.
newsitem.headline: Wrightson shrs hit year high of NZ$1.24.

text.p: Shares in New Zealand rural services group Wrightson Ltd rose to a year high on Monday amid a general equities rally after a general election.
Wrightson climbed four cents to NZ$1.24, its highest level since October 13, 1995. Shares traded totalled 301,670.

Ord Minnett broker Geoff Brown said Wrighton had given a number of presentations internationally in the last couple of weeks. "I expect that's what is seeing some increased interest in Wrightson," he said.

Brown also commented: "They're in the process of some reasonably major restructuring and I guess you could say the price reflects the extent to which people believe (chief executive) Greg Kay will bring that to pass."
At 3.20 p.m. (0220 GMT) Wrightson was steady at $1.24 while the NZSE-40 Capital Index was up 16.41 points at 2,265.96.
Brokers said the market's strength was something of a surprise given the New Zealand's uncertain political situation after an inconclusive general election on Saturday.
A government has still to be formed, with the New Zealand First Party holding the balance of power between the left and the right, and coalition negotiations yet to commence.
